exposure: Time interval between ECV and delivery
time interval between ECV and delivery
outcome: Factors predicting successful vaginal delivery after ECV
cohort: 301 women who attempted vaginal delivery after successful ECV
finding: Out of seven factors analyzed, only nulliparity was found to be a significant predictor of cesarean section and instrumental vaginal delivery in women who had a successful ECV.
mod_finding: The study investigated factors predicting cesarean section and instrumental vaginal delivery in women who had a successful external cephalic version.
